rationale: The assistant correctly said the trickling is very likely normal water-cooled condensing, hedged appropriately, and gave sensible leak checks (puddles, clothes dry) without recommending any part. It was long and generic, with cost and litre figures stated without a model to back them. It also suggested a water-meter check, which the customer later refuses, and it did not ask the make or model until the very end. Even so, the customer is well reassured and knows what to watch for.
